name: Family Schedule Coordination
prompt:
Help me arrange the family affairs for next month (2026年10月). The desktop family_calendars/ folder contains the calendars of our family of four (爸爸.ics, 妈妈.ics, 孩子A.ics, 孩子B.ics), and a family_notes.md that records fixed arrangements (such as piano lessons every Wednesday) and to-do items (such as vaccine appointments and parent-teacher meetings).
Please: 1) Summarize the whole family's schedule for next month and generate a shared calendar family_october.ics; 2) Mark the items with time conflicts that need coordination; 3) Assign all to-do items to specific dates and responsible persons, ensuring that no one forgets important matters; 4) Generate a textual explanation /root/Desktop/家庭事务安排.md that includes each person's view.
